Title: The Lost Convoy
Descriptions: A cargo ship carrying valuable supplies was attacked while unloading at the docks. Eliminate the hostile forces, secure the area, and search the containers for anything worth recovering.
We've received reports of a cargo ship that was attacked during unloading. Hostile forces are still in the area. Clear the dock and secure the remaining supplies.
Good work. The dock is secure, but the attackers moved part of the shipment. The man who survived this dock still needs help — talk to him before you leave.
